posts.text: Utdrag av melding i dag fra 2020 som omhandler Skandi Peregrino, bl.a.  "Furthermore, as announced by the Company on 22 September 2026, AHTS AS has received acceptances from all shareholders in Anchor Australia AS for the purchase by AHTS AS of their shares. Anchor Australia AS has entered into an agreement to purchase the large AHTS vessel “Skandi Peregrino”. The completion of AHTS AS’ acquisition of the shares in Anchor Australia AS is expected to be completed in conjunction with the delivery of “Skandi Peregrino” to Anchor Australia AS, expected during October 2026."
